pages:
Abstract
We compare two sorting approaches and claim general superiority.
Introduction
We ask whether method A improves sorting time.

Methods
Method A uses 100 inputs on one machine. Method B uses 1000 inputs on a different machine.
Results
A takes 2 ms and B takes 4 ms.
Conclusion
We conclude that A is faster for all input sizes.

known_issues.description: Unlike input sizes and hardware do not isolate the sorting method; the universal conclusion exceeds the experiment.
known_issues.provenance: Deliberately constructed synthetic defect, not an independent real-paper review
known_issues.match_criteria: Identify the differing input size or hardware as a confound and connect it to the unsupported speed comparison or general conclusion.
